subject: Implementation capacity for migration acceptance
message:
Hello Definian team,

Your migration work includes repeatable conversion and reconciliation to the original data. We can take one implementation slice through native loading, full-population acceptance, correction and editable handover.

We have prepared an operator around original dlt and DuckDB that retains source and pipeline state, compares every agreed business row, and checks keys, parent/child integrity and exact grouped totals. Findings and reviewer decisions remain separate, with a corrected edition and fresh verification before consumer selection. Complete source/runtime receiving is included.

Our proposed workshare is $9,600 over 15 active business days for up to four agreed CSV/JSON/NDJSON resources and named child-table mappings, Linux setup, acceptance/correction and editable handover. Payment is $4,800 at accepted scope and inputs, then $4,800 at the complete native result and handover. Live connectors and production changes can be scoped from actual intake.

Your team keeps the client relationship and business/production decisions. Who owns implementation capacity for current migration projects?

Bryce
